lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Friend! We have a situation!
What's up?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'm at the department store shopping for clothes.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: And goodness me,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: there are so many clothing stores to choose from!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I don't know where to start.
Are you shopping for yourself?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'm looking for something to give as a gift.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Hehe. Oh, I'm terrible at keeping secrets.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: In actuality,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'm here to buy something for you.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: But there are so many men's clothing stores!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Anyway, I wanted to ask you, what kind of clothing style do you prefer?
Something neat and put-together.
Something casual and laid-back.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Ah, so you like the neat and polished look!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Phew! It's a good thing I asked, or that could have gone badly.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: One moment.
There are no messages from Snow Crane for a while.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Okay, I found the section that has those styles.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Let me have a look.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: There's a navy shirt...

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Oh, and dark gray knit sweater. Which would you prefer?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: So you're more into the casual look. I see!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: What good information to know.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Then I'll browse around this area.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Let me have a look.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: There's a gray hoodie...

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Oh, and a white T-shirt. Which would you prefer?
Hard to say just from a description.
Can you send me some pictures?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Hehe, of course!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I know how to do that. You taught me recently.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Just a moment.
There are no messages from Snow Crane for a while.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: .qdglid;'o
What's going on?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Goodness, I'm sorry about that. I accidentally pressed some buttons.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Friend! We have a situation!
Again?

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I took the pictures,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: but I can't figure out how to attach them to a message.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Do I have to print them out first?
No, that's not how you do it.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Then, when I took the picture,

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: was it supposed to be in some special format for Bla?
No, that's not it either.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: It's not? I see...

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Well, phones these days can do anything.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Maybe all I have to do is hold it open and point it at the clothes?
I don't think I'll be able to explain this one to her...
Never mind. Don't worry about the pictures.
I don't need to see them.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Huh? Are you sure?
Just pick whichever one you think looks best.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Really? Is that okay?
Yeah, I can pull off pretty much anything.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Are you sure you won't be disappointed?
Not at all.
Gifts are better when they're a surprise anyway.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Ah, so you like surprises!

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Hehe, I should have realized sooner.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I should have been thinking more about what you'd like.
Don't worry about it, it's fine.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Okay then.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: I'll keep the rest a surprise.
Looking forward to it.

lines.speaker: snowcrane
lines.text: Hehe.
